cards.name: RedotPay Card
cards.physical: 100 USD (80 USD with RDPHY, 20% off); standard mail waived, DHL Express varies by country
cards.atm: USD card: 2% up to 10,000 USD/mo, 3% above; HKD card: 2% (+ conversion/FX if foreign currency)
cards.directAnswer: RedotPay is a stablecoin-first Visa for USDT/USDC spending, strong in emerging markets with restrictions that RedotPay's help center lists country by country (the US and Mainland China are on all four of its lists, Singapore is on the card issuance list, and the UK is not named). As of 2026-10-27 (L2, RedotPay Help Center fee table dated 2026-07-24): virtual issuance is $10 USD ($8 with RDVIR), physical $100 ($80 with RDPHY), 1% crypto conversion on USD swipes, 2.2% all-in on non-USD. Checkout total in the RedotPay app is authoritative.

cards.name: Binance Card
cards.virtual: 0 BRL (Brazil card, binance.com/en/cards); other regions: confirm in the app
cards.fx: 1–2% (Brazil card); an earlier Global/APAC schedule listed 2% on non-USD, not re-verified
cards.atm: 2 free withdrawals per month, then $1.50 each (Brazil card, binance.com/en/cards)
cards.directAnswer: Binance Card is country-specific and app-gated. As of 2026-10-12, Binance's card page (binance.com/en/cards) lists Brazil as the supported country for its BRL Mastercard: no annual or issuance fee (0 BRL), 0.9% crypto conversion, 1–2% foreign exchange fee, 2 free ATM withdrawals per month then 1.50 USD each, and up to 3% cashback. Figures we documented earlier for a Global/APAC USD card (0.1% USDC conversion, 2% FX with country exceptions) came from a Binance support article that is no longer online, so we could not re-verify them. The EU/UK Visa product was discontinued in Dec 2023 and the US/Canada are not supported. The Card tab must appear in your app.

cards.name: Ether.fi Cash Card
cards.physical: Free on Core; shipping fee applies (Luxe, Pinnacle and VIP get a metal card)
cards.fx: About 1% base + added margin: Core 0–0.5%, Luxe 0–0.25%, Pinnacle and VIP none
cards.atm: Up to $1,000 per withdrawal, max 5 per rolling 24h ($5,000); free up to 10/month on Pinnacle and VIP
cards.directAnswer: Ether.fi Cash is a non-custodial DeFi Visa where assets stay in a Gnosis Safe-style vault until spend. As of 2026-10-12 (L2, ether.fi Help Center): $0 annual; 3% USDC cashback on the first $2,000/mo on Core (larger bands on higher tiers); 0% FX on EUR merchants; about 1% base FX plus a tier margin on other foreign currency; ATM up to $1,000 per withdrawal. Best for ETH/USDC holders.

cards.name: Kast Card
cards.physical: $0 card fee + $40 delivery fee; additional virtual card $2 (Help Center, 2026-10-12)
cards.directAnswer: Kast is a USD-denominated Visa with stablecoin top-ups (USDC/USDT/USDe at 0% top-up fee). As of 2026-10-12 (L2, Kast Help Center): 0% on domestic USD card spend; non-USD FX 0.5–1.75%; cashback 1.5% on the first $2,000/mo (Standard), 2% on the first $10,000/mo (Premium), 3% on the first $40,000/mo (Private); ATM $3 + 2%. Premium costs $1,000/yr and Private $10,000/yr (kast.xyz/crypto-cards, checked 2026-10-12).

cards.name: Bitget Wallet Card
cards.virtual: 0.1 USDC within 72h of KYC; 10 USDC after (Base network only; Europe/Africa/LATAM fee page)
cards.fx: 1.7% conversion fee on non-USD spend; top-up free on the Europe/Africa/LATAM schedule, 1% top-up fee on the Mainland China schedule (Help Center, checked 2026-10-12)

cards.directAnswer: Bitget Wallet Card (distinct from Bitget exchange card) offers 2–3% assetback on spend. As of 2026-10-12 (L2, Bitget Wallet Help Center, fees vary by region): activation 0.1 USDC on Base within 72h of KYC (10 USDC after); $0 annual; physical $49 incl. shipping; welcome bonuses vary by campaign. Confirm product name says Wallet Card in-app.

cards.name: Nexo Card
cards.directAnswer: Nexo Card offers crypto-backed credit or debit spend in EEA, UK, and selected European markets. As of 2026-10-12 (L2, nexo.com EEA card page): $0 annual/monthly/inactivity; weekday FX 0.2% in EEA/UK/CH vs 2% elsewhere (+0.5% weekend surcharge); ATM free to tier limit then 2%; up to 2% NEXO cashback at Platinum loyalty. Credit mode carries LTV/APR risk.

cards.name: MetaMask Card
cards.directAnswer: MetaMask Card spends USDC/USDT/wETH via Linea delegation while funds stay self-custodied until authorized spend. Fees as of 2026-10-12 (L2, MetaMask Card limits and fees page): virtual $0 annual; Metal $199 annual; 0.875% on other crypto such as wETH (yield tokens such as aUSDC free up to $1,200/mo, then 0.5%); 0.5% on stablecoins in a currency that matches neither you nor the merchant; 1% cross-border (none on Metal, fair use); ATM 2% (Metal: free up to $1,200/mo). Availability as of 2026-08-29: EU/UK pilot (Baanx issuer); check the waitlist if the Card tab is missing, and confirm US availability in-app because MetaMask pages disagree.

cards.name: OKX Card
cards.directAnswer: OKX Card is an EEA/Norway virtual Mastercard (Jan 2026 launch) spending USDC/USDG with 0% OKX transaction and FX fees plus 0.1% stablecoin conversion spread. As of 2026-10-12 (L2, OKX EEA cashback FAQ updated 2026-09-28): non-VIP 2% USDG cashback capped €50/mo; VIP 4+ up to 10% capped €1,000/mo. Iceland and Liechtenstein excluded. Set USDG as payment currency for cashback.

cards.name: Crypto.com Visa Card
cards.fx: 2.0% on foreign transactions since 1 Sep 2026 (0.5% before); Help Center SG, 2026-09-01
cards.atm: Free $200–$1,000 USD/mo by tier; 2% above allowance + operator fees
cards.directAnswer: Crypto.com Prepaid Visa uses tiers (crypto.com/en/cards, verified 2026-10-12): Midnight Blue is free with 0% everyday CRO rewards; Ruby Steel ($4.99/mo) earns 1.5% CRO up to $750/mo, Jade Green and Royal Indigo ($29.99/mo) 2.5% up to $1,500/mo, Icy White and Rose Gold 3.5% up to $3,000/mo, Obsidian 4.5% up to $5,000/mo. ATM: $200–$1,000 USD/mo free by tier, then 2%. HK/APAC users often receive Singapore-issued cards — SG Help Center (6043620, dated 2026-09-01) lists Midnight FX at 2.0% since 1 Sep 2026 (0.5% before), Ruby no fee up to S$600/mo then 2.0%, Jade/Indigo no fee up to S$1,200/mo then 2.0%. Card to Fees & Limits in-app is authoritative.

cards.name: DPT Oxygen Card
cards.directAnswer: DPT Oxygen Visa Platinum (dpt.xyz/learn/what-is-dpt-pay, page updated 2026-05-25, re-checked 2026-10-12): virtual card $10 USD one-time, physical $50 USD (7–14 day ship).
